subject: Re: Kickoff: BUSTLE - decision: 2s timeout, ship the prototype
body:
Decision: option (a). Hard 2s timeout, return the best partial program with a "couldn't finish" affordance in the UI. 54% solve rate inside the budget is enough for a flag-gated prototype, and honestly the 61%-vs-44% retraining story is the number I'm taking into Q3 planning - OKRs lock Jun 26 and "formula suggestion GA decision by end of Q3" goes in as our committed item, funded from the B-77 earmark Bao lined up.

One scope cut with it: the 200-task mined benchmark stays internal-only for now. Kofi hasn't finished the privacy review of using customer formula history, even anonymized, and the 2-3 week SLA means we don't block M3 on it - the SyGuS numbers carry the external story until then.

Saoirse, July 20 M3 stands. Nice work team, the p95 analysis was exactly the right level of detail.

Dmitri
